title: When Do LLM-Elicited Priors Help? A Controlled Audit of Language Models as Priors for Small-Sample Bayesian Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.27075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked where to center the coefficients of a small-sample Bayesian regression, but the evidence is unclear: benchmarks are often built to match the prior and models may remember them. We audit this practice with one frontier and one flash-tier model, using hidden feature names, post-cutoff housing data and a pre-specified test that gives features the wrong descriptions. First, the models share their errors (correlation $0.92$--$0.99$ across draws, vendors and paraphrases): averaging $20$ draws is no more accurate than one, and treating draws as independent creates overconfidence. Much of this error comes from reporting each feature's effect alone, not with the others held fixed. Second, against the best classical prior, the LLM center helps clearly on one of four benchmarks (RMSE $-5.8\%$), marginally on two, and hurts mean RMSE on the fourth. Third, the LLM's stated uncertainty is unreliable;

translated_title: LLM引导的先验何时有用？语言模型作为小样本贝叶斯回归先验的受控审计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用来为小样本贝叶斯回归的系数确定中心位置，但相关证据并不明确：基准测试往往被设计成与先验相匹配，且模型可能已经记住了这些先验。我们使用一个前沿模型和一个快速层模型对这一做法进行了审计，采用隐藏的特征名称、截止日期之后的房价数据，以及一项预先设定的、故意给特征提供错误描述的测试。首先，这些模型的错误高度相关（在不同抽样、不同供应商和改写表述之间的相关性为0.92–0.99）：对20次抽样取平均并不比单次抽样更准确，而将各次抽样视为独立样本会导致过度自信。这种错误的很大一部分源于孤立地报告每个特征的效应，而不是在固定其他特征的情况下报告其效应。其次，与最佳的经典先验相比，LLM给出的先验中心仅在四个基准中的一个上带来了明显改进（RMSE降低5.8%），在两个基准上仅有边际改进，而在第四个基准上则恶化了平均RMSE。第三，LLM所声称的不确定性是不可靠的；
tldr: 该研究对LLM作为小样本贝叶斯回归先验的做法进行了受控审计，发现不同模型的先验误差高度相关（相关性达0.92–0.99）、其声称的不确定性不可靠，且相比最佳经典先验仅在四个基准中的一个上带来明显改进。
en_tdlr: This controlled audit of LLMs as priors for small-sample Bayesian regression finds that models share highly correlated errors (0.92–0.99), their stated uncertainty is unreliable, and their prior center clearly helps on only one of four benchmarks against the best classical prior.
